title: Publish provider wheel to internal package registry
reason: The Phase 3 request explicitly scopes registry publication as documentation/process work; no registry upload was authorized or required.
publication_procedure: Confirm Gate A and Gate B are PASS and bind the release to the immutable source commit, version, wheel digest, lockfile digest, and wheelhouse manifest.
Authenticate the least-privilege CI publisher through the secret mechanism; never place credentials in evidence or command transcripts.
Upload exactly the qualified wheel bytes to the approved internal hosted Python repository; do not rebuild, overwrite, delete-and-reupload, or use latest semantics.
Record the immutable package coordinate, registry response, returned digest, timestamp, release operator, and audit/run identity.
Download the package into a new empty directory using a consumer-like principal and independently SHA-256 the bytes.
Compare the download digest to the qualified digest, then run the complete clean-environment matrix from the registry copy before allowing rollout.
security_constraints: No token, DSN, environment value, or secret-bearing doctor output may enter retained evidence.
A same-name/version digest mismatch is a hard failure.
finding: No registry coordinate or publication receipt exists in this workspace.
